what: A button where the text cell and the 3em arrow cell are joined like one plate — on hover a .35em gap opens between the two cells (.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)), the text cell gets rounded on all four corners, the arrow cell becomes a 1.5em round circle, the arrow exits to the right at 140% and a new arrow enters from the left at -140% (.2s cubic-bezier(.65,.05,0,1)). On press the plate sinks 1px inward

options.look: accent is a plate in the accent color (subscribe button) · ghost is text only with no plate, a faint plate on hover (back button — the arrow slides out to the left). Default is the contrast stage color (black button). Putting the arrow slot first flips the corners·spacing
options.--fx-seam-color · --fx-seam-text: Panel and text colors, default --kf-contrast-bg and --kf-contrast-ink (accent type uses --kf-accent and --kf-on-accent)
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Arrow slot — duplicates the image inside into two sets and swaps them
options.--fx-seam-edge: 1px border color around each piece, none by default — when joined, the inner edges that touch are left empty and drawn once they separate (outline button ”Go back”)
